title: CarWala (Wheel Deals) - Car Selling Platform
description: A high-scale, premium automotive marketplace ecosystem. Features a mobile app integrated with Spring Boot REST APIs, supporting real-time car listings, dealer dashboards, and secure transaction workflows.
features: Built React Native mobile application integrated with Spring Boot REST APIs, supporting real-time car listings and dealer dashboards for 5,000+ users.
Built scalable backend using Spring Boot and MySQL to manage users, vehicles, pricing, and transaction workflows.
Implemented WebSocket-based real-time dealer-user chat and instant inventory updates.
Engineered secure media processing pipelines for uploading car videos (up to 500MB), reducing upload latency by 35%.

title: CareerPath - Duplicate File Detection System
description: A high-performance Java-based system for detecting duplicate files in large datasets using cryptographic hashing, multithreading, and event-driven processing.
features: Utilizes cryptographic hashing (SHA-256) to identify matching file contents across directories.
Features multi-threaded chunk processing for high throughput on large filesystems.
Built with Java and PostgreSQL for robust file index mapping and reporting.

title: ai-customer-support-bot
description: An automated AI Customer Support Bot designed to answer company FAQs, handle user tickets, and resolve customer queries in real-time.
features: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) using LangChain and Vector databases for high-context answers.
Interactive chat UI for real-time customer query resolution.
Dashboard for support agents to monitor and claim tickets escalated by the AI.

title: Forex Gold Trading Bot
description: A custom automated trading bot engineered for gold (XAUUSD) trading, utilizing technical indicators and risk management strategies to automate order execution.
features: Implements custom technical strategies (RSI, MACD, EMAs) with real-time MT5 integration.
Built-in risk management rules for stop-loss (SL) and take-profit (TP) order boundaries.
Historical backtesting engine to validate strategy performance on past gold market data.

title: DailyWorkerApp
description: A mobile application for workers and clients to manage hourly jobs, track shift logs, and secure payment disbursements.
features: Role-based mobile app for workers (logging hours, check-in) and clients (job postings, verification).
Offline capability utilizing local storage synchronization for remote worksite logging.
Automated invoice generation and payment tracking system.

title: NetScan Pro - Network Analyzer
description: A comprehensive network analysis tool for monitoring, scanning, and troubleshooting network infrastructure with real-time insights.
features: Network discovery and device fingerprinting using ARP/ICMP packets.
Real-time traffic monitoring and port scanning with custom reporting.
Web-based dashboard built with Django and WebSockets for interactive network topology mapping.

title: Campus Surveillance - Smart Tracking
description: An intelligent student tracking and face detection system for campus security. Features real-time monitoring and high-precision face recognition.
features: Real-time student trajectory tracking across campus corridors.
High-precision face detection and recognition using deep learning (OpenCV & YOLOv8).
Automated alerts for unauthorized entries and security dashboard reporting.
